Container.Name: paper-trading-bot
Container.Overview: I built this paper-only multi-coin day-trading simulator with a shared risk budget, deterministic demo data, and optional read-only Bitpanda Fusion market data. Before I apply this template, I create /mnt/user/appdata/paper-trading-bot/.env from .env.example. I keep PAPER_ONLY=true and DATA_DIR=/data, select APP_LANGUAGE=en or de, and select DATA_SOURCE=demo or fusion. For Fusion, I add FUSION_READ_API_KEY with Read permission only and leave Trade and Transfer disabled. The template loads that file, maps port 8787 and the persistent /data directory, runs as UID/GID 99:100, and applies a read-only hardened runtime. I expose no login, so I use the dashboard only inside a trusted LAN.
Container.Requires: I create /mnt/user/appdata/paper-trading-bot/data, assign it to nobody:users (99:100), and set mode 775. I create /mnt/user/appdata/paper-trading-bot/.env, assign it to root:root, and set mode 600. I configure PAPER_ONLY=true, DATA_DIR=/data, APP_LANGUAGE=en or de, DATA_SOURCE=demo or fusion, and a Read-only FUSION_READ_API_KEY only when I use Fusion. I follow docs/UNRAID.md for the complete installation and keep port 8787 inside a trusted LAN.
